description: Connects a custom domain to a Coreware-hosted website. Adds the A records that route the domain to Coreware infrastructure and the AWS ACM DNS validation CNAME required to issue its SSL certificate. Apply to an apex domain (no host) or a subdomain (host). For apex domains, the optional 'www' group also routes www to the apex domain and validates its SSL certificate.
variableDescription: routingIp1, routingIp2: Coreware load balancer static IPv4 addresses the domain's A records point to. acmValidationName: The ACM certificate validation CNAME host label relative to the domain being connected (e.g. _abc123def456). acmValidationValue: The ACM certificate validation CNAME target (e.g. _xyz.acm-validations.aws). wwwAcmValidationName: The ACM validation CNAME host label for the www subdomain relative to the apex domain (e.g. _def456.www). wwwAcmValidationValue: The ACM validation CNAME target for the www subdomain.
